organiser.name: Perth Design Week (co-founders Sandy Anghie and David Smith)

attendance.note: WA Government media statement: 2025 delivered 90+ events, 'drawing an estimated 50,000 attendees and more than 5,000 ticket registrations' (Google snippet). Mostly free exhibitions at WA Museum and CBD venues.

add_sources.note: 11 Feb 2026 statement: 'Perth Design Week delivered more than 90 events in 2025, drawing an estimated 50,000 attendees and more than 5,000 ticket registrations' (Google snippet; CITS WA news page repeats it).

2026 supporters page: Principal Partner State Government of WA ($100,000 to support the 2026 festival); Major Partners WA Museum, Humich Group, State Buildings, Block Branding; Major Sponsors Ligne Roset Perth, King Living; Major Donor Sandy Anghie (individual, not listed).

2026 Sponsors: Castledex, Cult, District, Ecopex, Entour, Human-Urban, Living Edge, Loam, Myaree Ceramics, Platformed, Southern Design Group, Stylecraft, URBIS, Zenith. Event Partners: FORM, Property Council of Australia.
Aug 2026: 2027 Major Sponsors Curtin University (partner since launch), Ligne Roset Perth and Cult (returning), Jardan (new); Human-Urban and Urbis return as Sponsors after two years.
Sep 2026: five new 2027 sponsors Loam, Castledex, Argent Australia, Spacio, Temple Fine Rugs; 'Interested in partnering with PDW 2027? Please DM us.'
2026 'PDW Digital Detox Lounge' at The Mark, State Buildings, created by Ligne Roset Perth and made possible by State Buildings; free entry, phones off, coffee and design books.
'If your organisation is interested in being a part of Perth Design Week in any way... hello@perthdesignweek.com'. Contact page: general enquiries to Sandy Anghie via the same address.
IG profile links to perthdesignweek.com; site announces PDW 2027, 11 to 18 March.
About page: co-founders Sandy Anghie and David Smith; launched October 2022, first festival 2023.
Official site event pages: 'Perth Design Week, March 19th - 26th, 2026' (Google snippet), resolving the Dezeen 20 Mar conflict.

remove_gaps: Organiser, official website and IG handle not captured in search results

notes: Strong find for High Ground: Ligne Roset Perth and State Buildings ran a 2026 'Digital Detox Lounge', a wellness-adjacent format. Sponsor base is design and furniture brands and growing for 2027 (Curtin University now a Major Sponsor); the organiser invites partners by email. About 50,000 estimated attendees in 2025.
